seo.title: Cura — Standalone Value Propositions
seo.description: Full Cura value with zero integration. Live in weeks on public flight data and what passengers submit — no PSS, no OCC, no IT project.

title.title: Full Cura value. Zero integration.
title.body: Live in weeks on public flight data and what passengers submit. No PSS, no OCC, no IT project.

cards.title: Smart intake
cards.body: Passengers see their actual flight times and the rules that apply, so they understand when a claim is not worth filing.

cards.title: Realistic expectations
cards.body: Passengers who ask for more than the regulated maximum are told the cap and asked for evidence of the extra cost.

cards.title: Verify every passenger
cards.body: Co-passengers confirm by email or e-signature. Full audit trail, no unauthorised claims.

categories.label: Category 02
categories.title: Keep the passenger, keep the cash

cards.title: Credits over cash
cards.body: Enhanced credits, vouchers or miles offered at any stage, before claim agencies step in.

cards.title: Goodwill offers
cards.body: Not eligible? A voucher or discount turns a rejection into a rebooking.

cards.title: Let passengers be heard
cards.body: A space for their story, and direct service feedback for Riyadh Air.

cards.title: Self-service tracking
cards.body: Automatic status updates. Fewer “where’s my claim?” contacts.

cards.title: AI document reading
cards.body: Receipts, boarding passes, invoices and baggage photos read and fraud-checked.

cards.title: AI recommendations
cards.body: Suggested decisions from the evidence and your rules. Agents make the call.

cards.title: Decide once per flight
cards.body: Set the disruption cause once; it applies to every claim on that flight.

cards.title: Rule-based automation
cards.body: Deterministic workflows run routine steps. Payout details collected up front.

cards.title: Authority and legal packs
cards.body: Evidence files for GACA and EU authorities, assembled automatically. Every ruling feeds back into Cura, so future decisions and packs get stronger.

cards.title: Sentiment monitoring
cards.body: Social and review mentions turned into claims or recovery offers.

cards.title: Claims insight
cards.body: Volume, cost and hotspots by route and flight, in one view.
